import datetime

# login again
phone_pw = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='phone'][0]
login_resp = apis.phone.login(username='9654124977', password=phone_pw)
token = login_resp['access_token']

# fetch all alarms (paginate)
all_alarms=[]
i=0
while True:
    page = apis.phone.show_alarms(access_token=token, page_index=i, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_alarms.extend(page)
    i += 1

print('total alarms:', len(all_alarms))
for a in sorted(all_alarms, key=lambda x: x['alarm_id']):
    print(a['alarm_id'], a['label'], a['time'], 'enabled=', a['enabled'])

# identify go-to-sleep alarm
sleep_alarms = [a for a in all_alarms if a.get('label') == 'Go to sleep']
print('sleep_alarms found:', [(a['alarm_id'], a['time'], a['enabled']) for a in sleep_alarms])
assert len(sleep_alarms)==1
sleep_alarm = sleep_alarms[0]

# compute new time 20 minutes later
hh, mm = map(int, sleep_alarm['time'].split(':'))
new_dt = datetime.datetime(2000,1,1,hh,mm) + datetime.timedelta(minutes=20)
new_time = new_dt.strftime('%H:%M')
print('go-to-sleep time:', sleep_alarm['time'], '->', new_time)

# disable all other alarms
other_enabled = [a for a in all_alarms if a['alarm_id'] != sleep_alarm['alarm_id'] and a.get('enabled')]
print('other enabled alarms to disable:', [(a['alarm_id'], a['label']) for a in other_enabled])

# update go-to-sleep alarm time (keep enabled True)
resp1 = apis.phone.update_alarm(alarm_id=sleep_alarm['alarm_id'], access_token=token, time=new_time, enabled=True)
print('update go-to-sleep resp:', resp1)

# disable others
results=[]
for a in other_enabled:
    r = apis.phone.update_alarm(alarm_id=a['alarm_id'], access_token=token, enabled=False)
    results.append((a['alarm_id'], r))
print('disable results:', results)

# verify
all_alarms2=[]
i=0
while True:
    page = apis.phone.show_alarms(access_token=token, page_index=i, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_alarms2.extend(page)
    i += 1

print('--- after update ---')
for a in sorted(all_alarms2, key=lambda x: x['alarm_id']):
    print(a['alarm_id'], a['label'], a['time'], 'enabled=', a['enabled'])

# sanity checks
sleep2 = [a for a in all_alarms2 if a.get('label')=='Go to sleep'][0]
print('sleep2 time/enabled:', sleep2['time'], sleep2['enabled'])
others2 = [a for a in all_alarms2 if a['alarm_id']!=sleep2['alarm_id']]
print('all others disabled?:', all(not a['enabled'] for a in others2))
